title: Groam Oxlint pattern rule
description: One `groam/<file name>` Oxlint rule that reports syntax whose source text matches `pattern`, in the files it is scoped to. `examples` are its lint fixtures.

match.description: `module-source`: import/export specifiers equal to the pattern; `node-text`: the full source text of the `nodes` kinds.

nodes.description: ESTree node kinds to check (node-text only), e.g. CallExpression, JSXAttribute, JSXOpeningElement.

pattern.description: A JavaScript regular expression source that must match the whole specifier or node text (`.` also matches newlines).

message.description: The diagnostic: what to use instead, and why.

files.description: Oxlint override globs the rule applies to. Prefix with **/ so lint fixtures in temporary directories match.

examples.description: Lint fixtures: `source` linted at repository path `file` must (or must not) report this rule. Include both kinds.
